workHistory.title: Influencer Work Archive
workHistory.subtitle: An internal collaboration history used to assess creator fit for future campaigns without creating duplicate influencer profiles.

workHistory.duplicate: A matching record already exists; no duplicate was created.

workHistory.importSubtitle: Upload previous-month collaboration archives. Each person is stored as a historical archive profile only and is not treated as a portal user until they self-register and an admin confirms any possible archive match.
workHistory.importHint: Required: Influencer Mobile and Campaign Name. Recommended: Influencer Name, City, Bio, Category, Username, Profile URL, Followers. Archive Year and Archive Month can be added for 2026 monthly files. Re-import fills missing values only and does not overwrite existing data.
workHistory.unmatchedInfluencer: The creator profile could not be matched or created for this mobile number.
workHistory.invalidRow: The row is missing required data.
workHistory.staffOnly: This archive is internal and visible to staff only.
